title: What a trumpet should do in a band
summary: Ferbos believes a trumpeter should carry the melody so listeners know what is being played.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Yeah. I wanted to ask you again about your own playing. What do you believe that a trumpet should do in a band? What kind of part should he take?

Well in my opinion a trumpet should carry a melody so they know what you're playing. And then if you vary it away from the melody, well I mean and then when you're going out you should have some melody involved so they know what you're playing.
You always believe in some melody. Yeah that's right, to let them know at least what you're playing.
